title: Spicy Thai Pomegranate Jjigae
description: A fusion twist on traditional Korean jjigae, with sweet and spicy Thai flavors, featuring fresh pomegranate seeds and a savory Thai red curry paste.
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add chili flakes, fish sauce, brown sugar, and rice vinegar. Stir to combine.
Add pomegranate seeds and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
Transfer to a serving dish and garnish with chopped cilantro (if using).
Serve immediately over steamed rice or noodles.
